scope: Vector and scalar spectral-window averaging of three or more independent stored visibility ordinates, including time and channel bins and scan and field spans.
baseline_result: Main refuses three or more independent stored visibility ordinates with SPW averaging. The intermediate standalone candidate also refuses the paired scan-span request.
evidence_reuse: The span change admits only SPW list requests with a time bin and a scan or field span. Reused standalone and unspanned samples, masks and rendering, then verified six span pairs. The final UVW admission fix has a separate focused regression and leaves these cases unchanged.
